description_en: Associates a gateway route table with an IPv4 gateway or an IPv6 gateway in the same VPC
description_zh: 调用AssociateRouteTableWithGateway接口将网关路由表和同一VPC内的IPv4网关、IPv6网关实例绑定
name: AssociateRouteTableWithGateway

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the gateway route table and the IPv4 gateway. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to query region IDs
parameters.help_zh:
要绑定的网关路由表和IPv4网关实例所在的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the gateway route table to be associated
parameters.name: route_table_id

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among multiple requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId of each API request may be different
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大值不超过64个ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId可能不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run. Valid values:
true: performs a dry run and does not associate the gateway route table with the IPv4 gateway. The system checks whether the required parameters are specified, the request format is valid, and the service limits are met. If the request fails the dry run, an error message is returned. If the request passes the dry run, the `DryRunOperation` error code is returned.
false (default): sends the request. If the request passes the dry run, an HTTP 2xx status code is returned and the gateway route table is associated with the IPv4 gateway
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：
true：发送检查请求，不会关联网关路由表和IPv4网关实例。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码`DryRunOperation`。
false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后返回HTTP 2xx状态码并直接关联网关路由表和IPv4网关实例
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID of the IPv4 gateway to be associated.

The IPv4 gateway instance must be in the Activated state
parameters.help_zh:
要关联的IPv4网关实例ID。

要关联的IPv4网关实例必须为已激活状态
parameters.name: gateway_id

parameters.help_en: The type of the gateway to be associated
parameters.help_zh: 要关联的网关实例的类型
parameters.name: gateway_type
